groups.title: BL-468 + BL-469 - the battle dispatches and the battle card (Sprint C3)

It could NOT be executed in this session's container: SDL3 is not installed, so `ProjectIo --verify` can be neither built nor run here. Both this row and R2 need a Windows run, and per the standing rule that a UI requirement needs a LIVE check, the card also needs the press clicked by hand - a scripted capture proves a surface renders, not that a press on it is reachable.

rows.requirement: THE FIELD CHANNEL CARRIES THE FIGHT. A staged battle produces at least one dispatch line on channel 1 (Field), and the aftermath line of a concluded battle appears there - which is the only place it CAN appear, since a concluded battle is erased at the end of the tick it ends.

rows.requirement: THE PHASE VOCABULARY IS DERIVED ONCE. The card's phase readout and the dispatch line's phrasing come from the SAME read_battle_phase call in the world layer, so the two surfaces cannot describe the same fight differently. Assert structurally - one derivation site - rather than by comparing two strings.
rows.result_metric: 6/6 phase values reachable
rows.notes: read_battle_phase lives in src/world/battle_system.hpp and is the only derivation site; battle_phase_word is the shared rendering of its result. Harness rows B13a-B13e exercise every phase value including the two terminal ones.

rows.requirement: THE DISPATCH LAYER CONSUMES NO DRAW. Phrase selection folds stream_seed with the round index rather than drawing, so text generation is structurally unable to move the simulation. Assert that the same fight replays to the same lines AND that wording varies across rounds of one fight - a bank that never varies and a bank that varies non-deterministically fail the same check from opposite sides.
rows.result_metric: 10 dispatches -> 6 distinct lines
rows.notes: B14e asserts replay-identity; B14f asserts variation. B14f's measured result is the interesting one: 10 dispatches from one fight produced 6 distinct lines, so the fold is live rather than degenerate.

rows.requirement: THE QUOTED PRICE IS THE CHARGED PRICE. What the card says withdrawing costs equals what withdrawing actually charges, in all three terms. The hazard is a second copy of the resolver's arithmetic inside the card drifting from the resolver's own.
rows.result_metric: quote == charge, 3/3 terms
rows.notes: B12b asserts quote_withdrawal() against the charge the resolver applies. Structurally the card cannot drift: it renders the quote rather than recomputing anything.

rows.requirement: NO BANK HAS A HOLE, AND NO TOKEN SURVIVES UNSUBSTITUTED. Every phase's bank is non-empty and every %-token in every template resolves. B14b initially asserted 'no % survives in output' and was WRONG rather than the code - '89%' is a legitimate line - so the row is tightened to flag only a % followed by a token letter.

rows.requirement: A MISSING CORP DEGRADES TO A NOUN. A dispatch naming a corp that has gone (disbanded, or a regenerated world) reads as prose, never as an empty string or a raw id - this layer must not be the thing that LOOKS broken.

groups.title: Sprint 28 (re-scoped) - a quarter of worlds fight no war, and the scorer is why

So the floor cannot yet be derived from a real gate and must be stated as a judgement until the ancient tech quests are authored - at which point their reachability should be checked against THIS band rather than designed independently of it.

rows.requirement: THE FORK IS SEPARATED BEFORE ANY FIX. The instrument distinguishes 'campaign never cleared campaign_threshold_q' from 'campaign cleared it and lost the > comparison to another verb' - and where it loses, names the winning verb and the margin. Until this row passes, no fix may be written: the two cases need different fixes and the code cannot currently tell them apart.
